extraction.notes: Read in full: pages 1-18 (the whole document; text pages equal PDF pages, printed page numbers run from 1 on text page 4). Romanian only: stated_text is the Romanian text as converted, translation_en is the extracting agent's translation, machine_translated is true and evidence confidence is capped at Medium. Scope: only actions meeting the technology materiality test. In scope: online public services and payments (MPay), digitalisation of public services (5.1.1), new state registers and information systems (civil status, legal entities, population register, 5.2.1), the e-procurement system (6.10.3, in progress), and three doubtful items (particip.gov.md promotion, the E-Legiferare track, and the SIA CIMAI online reporting system). No Chapter 2 content. Left out as general public administration reform: the overall implementation rates by pillar (pages 2-3, including Pillar V service delivery, 86.67%), policy planning and monitoring (including the e-Monitorizare indicator system, 2.2.1, a policy planning tool), civil service and HR, restructuring of central administration, access to information and website transparency monitoring (publishing online is incidental), internal audit, public procurement training, public investment, legislative drafting and salary reform. Also out: delivery of identity documents (5.1.4, not described as digital) and government decisions on civil status document models. Problem with the text: its table on page 3 counts 109 actions carried out (including continuous or annual ones), 20 in progress and 4 not started, but the detailed list gives 26 actions carried out and only 5 in progress, with no section on actions not started; the document ends at page 18 in both the PDF and the text file, so the remaining in-progress and not-started actions are not available in this source. Several table cells run over page breaks and are interrupted by action-column text. Doubtful for the analyst: items 0001, 0002, 0010 and 0011 are flagged theme_doubtful. Second-pass check (PC-05) by checker-GOV8f on 5 November 2026: 3 items added (review/RUN-2026-02/second_pass/MDA-GOV-2026-011.csv).

items.stated_text: Ghidarea autorităților publice și promovarea utilizării conforme a portalului particip.gov.md au fost realizate în cadrul sesiunilor de dialog pe marginea ghidurilor privind transparența procesului decizional, precum și organizarea și funcționarea platformelor consultative permanente, desfășurate în perioada martie– septembrie 2025, în toate cele 14 ministere.
items.translation_en: Guidance to public authorities and promotion of the proper use of the particip.gov.md portal were carried out in dialogue sessions on the guidelines on transparency in decision-making and on the organisation and functioning of permanent consultative platforms, held from March to September 2025 in all 14 ministries.
items.summary: Use of the online public consultation portal particip.gov.md was promoted in all 14 ministries from March to September 2025.
items.intervention_as_stated: Promovarea și sporirea nivelului de utilizare a platformei online de consultare publică particip.gov.md (acțiunea 2.5.9)
items.extraction_note: Table row; quote from the Finalitatea (result) column. Theme doubtful: particip.gov.md is an online platform the public uses, but the action is promotion and guidance on decision-making transparency rather than the platform itself. Four training sessions for local authorities (25 November to 10 December 2025, page 5) not extracted separately.

pass2.classification_note: E-participation or e-consultation platform, not a transactional e-service; RI-TEC-008 retired at G4 of RUN-2026-01, no other issue fits (as in A01 to A04 and C01). Promotion and guidance on decision-making transparency.

items.stated_text: Platforma digitală a fost dezvoltată prin crearea în sistemul E -Legiferare a pistei „Parlament–Președintele RM”, prin intermediul căreia sunt monitorizate inițiativele legislative ale Guvernului la toate etapele procesului legislativ.
items.translation_en: The digital platform was developed by creating in the E-Legiferare system the 'Parliament-President of the Republic of Moldova' track, through which the Government's legislative initiatives are monitored at all stages of the legislative process.
items.summary: A digital track in the E-Legiferare system now lets the Government monitor its legislative initiatives through Parliament.
items.intervention_as_stated: Crearea unui sistem digital funcțional pentru coordonarea activității între Parlament și Guvern (acțiunea 2.7.3)
items.extraction_note: Table row; quote from the Finalitatea (result) column. Theme doubtful: an internal government system, but the action itself is framed as creating a digital system for coordinating Parliament and Government (digital transformation of administration).

pass2.classification_note: Theme doubtful: a government-wide system for coordinating legislative initiatives read as a shared administrative information system; doubtful fit, could be read as back-office (R22); flagged for the analyst.

items.summary: A methodology on institutionalising life events for citizens and businesses was approved in December 2025 under the action on digitalising public services.
items.intervention_as_stated: Metodologia privind instituţionalizarea evenimentelor de viaţă pentru cetăţeni şi afaceri (Ordinul CS nr. 331 din 18.12.2025)

items.stated_text: Serviciul guvernamental de plăți electronice (MPay) asigură încasarea plăților în favoarea Serviciilor Publice ASP, punând la dispoziția plătitorilor o gamă diversificată de instrumente de plată: la ghișeele băncilor sau la Poșta Moldovei, prin e -commerce, terminale POS, terminale de tip self -service, portofele electronice, internet/mobile banking, precum și platforme de tip Apple Pay și Google Pay.
items.translation_en: The government electronic payment service (MPay) collects payments for the Public Services Agency (ASP), offering payers a wide range of payment instruments: bank counters or Moldova Post, e-commerce, POS terminals, self-service terminals, e-wallets, internet and mobile banking, and Apple Pay and Google Pay.
items.summary: The MPay government e-payment service collects payments for Public Services Agency services through many channels, including online and mobile.
items.extraction_note: Table row; quote from the Finalitatea (result) column. Reported under action 5.1.3 (technical conditions for advance payment for identity document services).

pass2.classification_note: Shared payment building block used for a sector body's services.

items.stated_text: Toate achitările efectuate prin MPay pot fi considerate prealabile, inclusiv cele aferente eliberării actelor de identitate, întrucât prestarea serviciului are loc doar după confirmarea achitării. Statutul plății este transmis în timp real către sistemul informațional al ASP imediat după finalizarea tranzacției.
items.translation_en: All payments made through MPay can be considered advance payments, including those for issuing identity documents, because the service is provided only after payment is confirmed. The payment status is transmitted in real time to the ASP information system immediately after the transaction.
items.summary: MPay payment status is sent to the Public Services Agency's information system in real time, so all MPay payments count as advance payments.
items.extraction_note: Table row; quote from the Finalitatea (result) column. Recorded as a finding: it describes how the system works and names no new measure.

pass2.classification_note: Finding on how MPay is applied (integration with the ASP information system).

items.stated_text: Începând cu anul 2025, grupul de utilizatori ai Sistemului informațional de raportare „Control intern managerial și audit intern” (SIA CIMAI) a fost extins prin includerea autorităților publice locale de nivelul II și a autorităților/instituțiilor publice din subordinea acestora.
items.translation_en: From 2025, the user group of the reporting information system 'Managerial internal control and internal audit' (SIA CIMAI) was extended to include second-level local public authorities and the authorities and institutions subordinated to them.
items.summary: The online internal control reporting system SIA CIMAI was extended in 2025 to second-level local authorities and their subordinate bodies.
items.intervention_as_stated: Digitalizarea procesului de monitorizare și analiză a controlului intern managerial prin platforma electronică de raportare (SIA CIMAI)
items.extraction_note: Table row; quote from the Finalitatea (result) column. Theme doubtful: a public finance reporting system used by authorities, but the action is framed as 'Digitalizarea procesului de monitorizare' (digitalising a government process).

pass2.classification_note: Theme doubtful: government-wide internal control reporting platform used by all central and second-level local authorities, read as a shared administrative information system (as the civil service HR system, MDA-EU-2023-001-0009); doubtful fit, could be read as a back-office public finance system (R22); flagged for the analyst.

items.stated_text: Astfel, în anul 2025, utilizând platforma de raportare online „Control intern managerial și audit intern” ( https://raportare-cfpi.mf.gov.md/), toate cele 67 de autorități publice (32 APC și 35 APL de nivelul II) au prezentat către Ministerul Finanțelor rapoartele anuale consolidate privind controlul intern managerial, atingând un nivel maxim de raportare de 100%.
items.translation_en: Thus in 2025, using the online reporting platform 'Managerial internal control and internal audit', all 67 public authorities (32 central and 35 second-level local) submitted their consolidated annual internal control reports to the Ministry of Finance, a 100% reporting rate.
items.summary: All 67 central and second-level local authorities submitted annual internal control reports through the online platform in 2025, a 100% rate.
